en.askTitle: Swap in your own arrival date, housing and payday, and get the same ordered first-30-days plan for your Employment Pass
en.runTitle: Manila to Singapore: a calm 30-day plan for a data analyst landing on 4 January 2027

fields.label: Passport and departure status
fields.value: Flying out of Manila, alone with two suitcases

fields.label: Arrival date and actual in-principle approval conditions
fields.value: Landing 4 January 2027 on an Employment Pass, in-principle approval received

fields.label: Temporary stay and any unpaid bill
fields.value: Serviced apartment for the first 2 weeks

fields.label: Office location
fields.placeholder: e.g. an office near Raffles Place

fields.label: Rent and house rules
fields.value: A room or a studio near the CBD and in 2–3 cheaper areas, after the first 2 weeks

fields.label: Accessible funds
fields.placeholder: e.g. S$6,000 across a Philippine card and cash

fields.label: Payroll cutoff and credit date
fields.value: Paid at the end of January

en.template: Plan my Singapore EP arrival using {passport}, {arrival}, {stay}, {office}, {rent}, {funds} and {payroll}. Separate issuance, registration and card delivery; match bank and phone documents; show move-in cash, stamp deadlines and fallback accommodation. Give me a practical checklist. Plan only; do not apply, contact anyone, book or pay.

phases.title: Read the official rules and gather dated prices for banks, phones, housing and transport
phases.note: Immigration and pass steps, bank onboarding, mobile plans, rooms and studios
phases.judgment: Two official sources disagree on when the Singpass sign-up starts, so it reported both versions side by side rather than quietly picking one.

phases.title: Write the week-by-week plan, cost tables and a register of every source and calculation
phases.note: A 35-item checklist, four phone providers, two ways to send money, 13 dated room and studio listings

phases.title: Check the page at desktop and phone width, plus an independent review of dates and arithmetic
phases.judgment: A separate reviewer recomputed the dates, stamp-duty examples and budget and found them all matching. It also caught that the page had treated the traveller's nationality as a given when it was never stated, and asked for a fallback if the bank account is not ready before payroll cutoff.

workers: Read the official immigration, pass, Singpass and tax pages to pin down what happens at arrival, card registration and tenancy stamp duty
Collected current mobile plan prices from four providers, ID rules for keeping a number, and January train and bus fares
Checked which banks let a new pass holder open an account with what documents, and how money can be sent from the Philippines
Gathered dated room and studio listings in central and cheaper areas, plus deposit and agent-fee norms
Independent review of the finished page and source notes: recomputed dates and sums, checked how firmly each claim is supported

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的抵达日期、住处和发薪日，就能得到同样一份按顺序排好的新加坡雇佣准证落地 30 天计划
zh.runTitle: 从马尼拉到新加坡：数据分析师 2027 年 1 月 4 日落地的 30 天安排

fields.label: 护照及出境身份
fields.value: 从马尼拉出发，一个人，带两个行李箱

fields.label: 抵达日期和实际 IPA 条件
fields.value: 2027 年 1 月 4 日落地，持雇佣准证，已收到原则性批准

fields.label: 办公地点
fields.placeholder: 例如：办公室在莱佛士坊附近

fields.label: 租金及房屋规则
fields.value: 两周后租房：市中心附近和 2–3 个较便宜的区域，单间和一居室都看

fields.label: 可动用资金
fields.placeholder: 例如：菲律宾银行卡加现金共约 6,000 新币

fields.label: 工资资料截止及到账日

zh.template: 请按 {passport}、{arrival}、{stay}、{office}、{rent}、{funds} 和 {payroll} 安排新加坡 EP 落地计划。分清签发、登记和送卡，匹配银行及手机材料，列明入住资金、印花税期限和备用住宿，给我实用清单。只做规划，不申请、不联系、不预订或付款。

phases.title: 读官方规则，收集银行、手机、住房和交通的带日期价格
phases.note: 入境和准证步骤、银行开户、手机套餐、单间和一居室房源
phases.judgment: 两处官方说法对新加坡个人数字身份（Singpass）从什么时候开始注册不一致，它把两种说法并排写明，没有擅自选一个。

phases.title: 写出按周排列的计划、费用表，以及每个来源和每笔计算的登记册
phases.note: 35 项清单、4 家手机运营商、2 种汇款方式、13 条带日期的房源

phases.title: 用电脑和手机宽度打开页面检查，并让独立同事复核日期和算术
phases.judgment: 独立复核同事把日期、印花税例子和预算重新算了一遍，全部对得上；同时指出页面把「护照国籍」当成了已知事实（用户其实没说），还建议补一条：发薪截止前银行账户还没开成怎么办。

workers: 读官方移民、准证、Singpass 和税务页面，弄清落地、办卡登记和租约印花税这几步怎么走
收集四家运营商当前的手机套餐价格、保留号码的证件规则，以及 1 月的地铁和公交票价
查新准证持有人能在哪些银行开户、要带什么材料，以及怎样从菲律宾汇钱过来
收集市中心和较便宜区域带日期的单间、一居室房源，以及押金和中介费的惯例
独立复核成稿和来源说明：重算日期和金额，检查每条说法的依据有多牢
